categories.main_business_segments: Hainan Airport Infrastructure Co., Ltd. operates primarily in airport management, duty-free and commercial business, real estate development and sales, property management, and hotel and catering services. The airport management segment includes both aeronautical and non-aeronautical services such as landing, parking, passenger services, security, retail, advertising, cargo, and office leasing. The duty-free and commercial segment involves duty-free store operations and commercial real estate leasing. Real estate includes development projects and property sales, while property management covers a broad range of services including residential and commercial properties. The company also operates hotels and provides flight simulation training services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced airport operation technologies including digital transformation using big data and artificial intelligence for smart airport construction and management. It utilizes intelligent systems for gate allocation, flight delay prediction, smart security checks, and environmental monitoring. In real estate and infrastructure, it applies modern construction and project management techniques. Flight simulation training leverages sophisticated simulation equipment and certified training programs. The company also integrates technology in property management and commercial operations to enhance efficiency and customer experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include airlines, passengers, cargo operators, retail and duty-free operators, commercial tenants, real estate buyers and lessees, property management clients, hotel guests, and aviation training participants. The company serves the civil aviation sector, retail and tourism industries, real estate market, and hospitality sector. Its airports cater to domestic and international travelers, with a focus on the Hainan Free Trade Port and surrounding regions. The duty-free business targets travelers and tourists, while real estate and property management serve both commercial and residential clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with a strong presence in Hainan Province, including major airports such as Sanya Phoenix International Airport and Haikou Meilan International Airport. It also manages and holds stakes in airports across other Chinese cities including Anqing, Tangshan, Weifang, Yingkou, Manzhouli, Yichang, Dongying, Songyuan, and Sansha. Real estate and commercial projects are concentrated in Hainan and extend to cities like Tianjin, Shenyang, Changchun, Wuhan, and Chengdu. The company’s operations are focused on domestic markets with strategic emphasis on the Hainan Free Trade Port.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the aviation and real estate supply chains. It manages airport operations and infrastructure, provides commercial and retail services within airports, and develops and manages real estate and property assets. It also offers ancillary services such as flight training and hotel management. The company acts as an operator and service provider rather than a raw material supplier or manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on creating a world-class airport operation group, leveraging digital transformation and technological innovation to build smart, low-carbon airports. It prioritizes the development of the Hainan Free Trade Port, expanding international routes, and enhancing airport service quality. The company is advancing the integration of airport operations with duty-free retail, commercial real estate, and property management to build an integrated airport economy. It also emphasizes the development of the aviation logistics and manufacturing industry, flight training, and sustainable practices. R&D efforts focus on intelligent airport management systems and aviation technology.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams including aeronautical fees (landing, parking, passenger services), non-aeronautical airport services (retail, advertising, office leasing), duty-free and commercial property leasing, real estate sales and leasing, property management fees, hotel operations, and flight training services. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. Revenue is primarily transactional, based on service fees, sales, and leasing contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading state-owned airport infrastructure operator in Hainan and holds a significant position in the regional aviation market, especially within the Hainan Free Trade Port. It competes with other airport operators in China, particularly in the South China aviation market, and faces competition in real estate and property management sectors from local and national players. Its integrated business model combining airport operations with commercial and real estate development differentiates it from pure airport operators. The company benefits from strong government backing and strategic location advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.37 billion, a decrease of 35.4% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 458.5 million, down 51.88%. Total assets stood at about RMB 53.69 billion with net assets of RMB 23.52 billion. The company experienced a decline in revenue mainly due to reduced real estate sales but maintained stable airport operations with over 24.6 million passengers served. It continues to invest heavily in airport expansion and real estate projects, with a focus on sustainable growth and leveraging the Hainan Free Trade Port policies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company leverages its strategic location in the Hainan Free Trade Port and its integrated business model combining airport operations, duty-free retail, real estate, and property management to offer unique value. It emphasizes professional management, high service quality certified by international standards, and innovative digital and smart airport solutions. Its extensive airport network and commercial properties provide a comprehensive platform for passenger and cargo services, retail, and tourism. The company’s commitment to sustainability, technological innovation, and multi-industry synergy differentiates it in the competitive aviation and real estate markets.
